title: Rovo Agent Manifest
description: Schema for rovo-agent.yaml — defines an Atlassian Studio Rovo agent for automated provisioning.

identity.description: Agent identity — maps to the Identity page in Studio.

name.description: Agent display name (max 30 characters in Studio).

description.description: Short agent description (max 400 characters in Studio).

avatar.description: Optional emoji avatar for the agent.

behavior.description: Multi-line behaviour text (tone, style, approach). Maps to the Behaviour field in Studio. Can be an inline string or a $file reference.

conversationStarters.description: Optional conversation starter prompts shown to users (max 3 in Studio).

scenarios.description: Agent scenarios — maps to the Scenarios section in Studio.

knowledgeSources.description: Knowledge sources for scenarios using 'custom' knowledge. Maps to the Custom Knowledge dialog in Studio.

fileRef.description: Reference to an external file whose text contents replace this value. The path is resolved relative to the rovo-agent.yaml directory.

$file.description: Relative path to a text file (e.g. './scenarios/default/instructions.md'). Must not be absolute or escape the directory with '..'.

stringOrFileRef.description: Either an inline string or a { $file: './path' } reference to external file content.

defaultScenario.description: The default scenario — always present, has no trigger, and no deep research toggle.

instructions.description: Multi-line instructions for the agent in this scenario. Can be an inline string or a $file reference.

skills.description: Skills (actions) available in this scenario. Use the display name from Studio (e.g., 'Create page', 'Create work item').

customScenario.description: A custom scenario with a natural-language trigger.

trigger.description: Natural language trigger description (e.g., 'When someone asks about getting a replacement laptop').

instructions.description: Multi-line instructions for the agent in this scenario. Can be an inline string or a $file reference.

deepResearch.description: Enable deep research capability (only available on custom scenarios in Studio).

enabled.description: Whether the scenario is enabled. Studio requires a trigger before enabling.

knowledgeSource.description: A knowledge source integration (Confluence, Jira, JSM, or Atlassian Support Docs).

filter.description: Filter expression — 'all' for all content, or a specific space/project identifier.
